name: infino
description: Keyword, semantic, hybrid, and SQL retrieval for AI agents — RAG, persistent agent memory, and search over your own data, stored as plain Parquet on object storage. Local embeddings, no API key; point it at a path, a bucket, or Infino Cloud.

infino_uri.title: Infino data URI
infino_uri.description: Data to serve: a local path (e.g. /Users/me/.infino/memory), an s3://|gs://|az:// bucket URI, or a hosted https://<host>/<database> endpoint (Infino Cloud).

infino_api_key.title: Infino Cloud API key
infino_api_key.description: API key for a hosted https:// endpoint. Leave blank for a local path or bucket URI. The key's capabilities decide what the agent may do; the server itself has no write gate.
